notes: floor_y = floor under the walked path at s (world y). Camera height 1.40 m validated from standing people (102 frames: 1.421 m for 1.70 m people, track horizon within 0.019 of image height); raw monocular depth puts the floor only 1.06 m below the camera, so depth is re-calibrated to the floor before use. Lateral offsets are along the smoothed-path right vector (-tz, tx) exactly as brain.lanePoint. Pose seams (floor jumps with the camera; a target across a seam is seen from the other fragment): frames [1427, 3106, 3510]. Use floor_y at the guide's OWN s (nearest path point), never the target's: on stairs the floor rises up to 1.12 m between 2.0 and 5.2 m ahead.
